about: Law keys the automatic pinning commands (fetch_batch5.py laws / missing, and every batch fetcher built on it) never pin: each was pinned once from a note link, and headyear.py showed that the page at the link is a different act. `gap <id> <url>` still pins a key on purpose.

keys.law:mp-144-2003: the linked pages (MPV/144.htm, MPV/Antigas_2003/144.htm) are Lei 9.427/1996, not MP 144/2003 (removed in parts zzv and zzw)
keys.law:mp-181-2004: the linked page (_Ato2004-2006/2004/Mpv/181.htm) is Lei 10.438/2002, not MP 181/2004 (removed in part zzw)
keys.law:dl-900-1968: misprinted key: the linked page is Decreto-Lei 900 of 29.9.1969 (removed in part zzm after the NOTE_FIX)
keys.law:mp-246-1997: misprinted key: Lei 9.491's note reads 'Medida Provisória nº 246, de 1997'; the linked page is Medida Provisória 246 of 6.4.2005 (pinned as law:mp-246-2005; removed in part zzzc)
